'''2012 European Championship Angelo Consoli LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned (V)}}
* '''Username:''' GravityShadow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
